title: Chiaroscuro
description: Chiaroscuro lighting uses strong light-dark contrast to model volume and to create moral, psychological, or dramatic tension. Darkness withholds; the lit plane is what the scene will admit.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: A single warm source, a face turning into light, the rest of the room falling away: the audience reads character as a matter of what remains visible. Tenebrism is the hard end of this, where everything beyond arm's reach is black.
Crime, period night, and religious doubt all use the same physics. It is the wrong tool for a wide that must describe architecture, or for comedy that needs a second face in the shadows.
Underexposing an even room is not chiaroscuro. You have to place a key and let falloff do the cutting.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Place one motivated key (window, lamp, candle), reduce fill, and flag spill. The key is often warm, slightly high, and small enough to fall off fast.
Hardness can be moderately hard so planes of the face turn quickly. Keep enough separation that eyes and hands in the pool stay legible.
Prompt: Chiaroscuro lighting on [Subject], Caravaggio tenebrism, a single warm source, everything beyond arm's reach falling into black.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it when light is moral and darkness hides or judges, for example a confession across a desk lamp. Do not use it as a global grade on a daylight street.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: Low-key lighting is the broader contrast strategy; chiaroscuro insists on modeled volume, not just a dark frame. Rembrandt lighting is a specific cheek-triangle pattern that often lives inside chiaroscuro.
Cameo lighting isolates against void and may flatten the world to a stage cutout. Hard light helps the cut but is not required if falloff is steep.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: The Godfather's dark office against the wedding outside is textbook withholding. The Third Man uses Vienna night so figures appear and vanish in designed dark.
Barry Lyndon and The Night of the Hunter both let a single source model faces while the room dies.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: One source, fast falloff, modeled planes. " Name the lamp.
Forbid extra fill and even ambient.

A tailor listens to an uneasy visitor in a dim back room. One high window shapes half the tailor’s face; the rest falls into deep but readable shadow. Warm desk practical in the distance, no even beauty fill, no crushed featureless blacks.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is muddy underexposure. The tell is no key direction and featureless blacks.
Fix it by placing one warm source, flagging bounce, and exposing the lit planes.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is chiaroscuro in film?
Strong light-dark contrast used to model volume and to create tension. Selected areas are lit; substantial parts of the image stay dark on purpose.
Chiaroscuro vs Rembrandt lighting
Chiaroscuro is the overall contrast language. Rembrandt lighting is a portrait pattern: a triangle of light on the shadow-side cheek.
When should I use chiaroscuro?
Use it when what is hidden matters as much as what is shown: confession, crime, night bargains. Skip it when the whole room must read.
How do I prompt chiaroscuro for AI image or video?
Specify a single warm source, faces modeled, everything beyond arm's reach falling into black. No extra fill, no even room tone.
